Hi Hannah — welcome and thanks for the attachments. Short answers up front:

- Preferred: Vendor Portal (link below) — this gives faster routing and automatic PO stamping.
- Email fallback: accounts@redwood-invoice.com is supported, but please follow the subject/filename rules listed below.
- Required invoice fields for automated intake: PO#, invoice date, invoice number, remit-to name + address, line item description, quantity, unit price, currency, and total. Tax ID should be included on vendor profile; include it on the invoice if you collect US sales tax.

Practical guidance:
- Portal upload: Portal will validate PO numbers against open POs and prompt if a match can’t be found. Use the portal when possible: https://portal.redwood-inference.com/vendor-onboard/NOVA-12345
- Email rules (only when portal unavailable):
  * Subject line: Redwood Invoice — PO <PO#> — <InvoiceNumber>
  * Attachment filename: <VendorName>_INV_<InvoiceNumber>.pdf (single PDF per invoice)
  * If the invoice covers multiple POs, separate files per PO is preferred.

I’m CC’ing Marissa (AP process) and Ben (vendor ops) to confirm mapping and any exceptions for partner onboarding.

If you want, Ben can provision a sandbox account in the portal so you can test an upload.

Best,
Evelyn

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for sending the samples. A few implementation notes from AP:

- PO matching: we match on PO# (exact) plus vendor name; if the PO is split across multiple lines the portal will try to allocate, but include PO line references in the invoice if possible.
- Required metadata in the portal form: PO#, invoice number, invoice total, remittance email, remit address, payment terms (e.g., Net 30). These are required for automated routing to the payment queue.
- Exceptions: If your invoice uses a legacy PO format (e.g., PO-2026-XXXX), flag the PO in the portal comments so we can map it.

Sandbox: I can create a sandbox login for you (no impact to production). Reply with the user email you want provisioned.

Couple of small asks to help avoid delays:
- Use PDF (not images) and make sure the PO# is in the body of the PDF (not only on a scanned cover page).
- Include one invoice per PDF.

If you’re comfortable, send the sandbox user and I’ll set it up this afternoon.

— Ben
